title: v0.12.3
excerpt: Added 🔐 End-to-end encrypted chats. Direct messages and private group channels can now hold a temporary end-to-end encrypted chat: a member picks Encrypted Chat in the channel menu, the other members see "Encrypted chat in progress" with a Join link, messages of up to 16 KiB are encrypted in the browser with MLS and only passed through the server without being saved, participants can verify each other by comparing codes and see when others are typing, and the chat is cleared when you leave or reload and ends when channel membership or access changes. Administrators turn it on under Admin Settings > General > Encrypted channels or with "ENABLE_ENCRYPTED_CHANNELS" and grant it with the new Encrypted Channels permission, off by default or set with "USER_PERMISSIONS_FEATURES_ENCRYPTED_CHANNELS", and it needs websocket connections with websocket server logging off and HTTPS in production. Commit , Commit , Commit , Commit 📡 Much lighter streaming with Redis. With Redis, a streaming reply is now stored under its own key and new text is appended to it instead of rewriting the whole reply into a shared hash on every update, and replies started on older instances are still read during an upgrade; with room channels on, each instance now only subscribes to the rooms of people connected to it, so Redis no longer sends it live updates for chats it does not serve. Commit Commit #32478 🔍 Compare view options and undo. The Compare revision view has a Comparison options menu to ignore whites
